feats.title: Deadly Immobilization
feats.description: Whenever you slow or immobilize a target with a swordmage or swordmage paragon path attack power, that power deals extra damage equal to your *Constitution*.

feats.title: Distant Swordbond
feats.description: You can call your bonded weapon to your hand from up to 1 mile away as a minor action.

feats.title: Double Aegis
feats.description: When you use your Swordmage Aegis power, you can choose to also mark a second target within the burst. If both targets attack your allies, you must choose which of the targets to respond to. (You still have only one immediate action per round.)

feats.title: Ensnaring Flourish
feats.description: When you use aegis of ensnarement to teleport an enemy, you gain a +5 bonus to damage rolls on melee attacks against that enemy until the end of your next turn.

feats.title: Greater Aegis of Shielding
feats.description: When you use your aegis of shielding to reduce the damage from an enemy's attack, you reduce the damage by an additional 5 points.

feats.title: Greater Swordmage Warding
feats.description: While your Swordmage Warding is active, you gain a +1 feat bonus to all defenses. At 21st level, this bonus increases to +2.

feats.title: Timely Teleport
feats.description: When you use second wind, you can also teleport a number of squares equal to your *Intelligence* as a free action.

feats.title: Vigorous Assault
feats.description: When you use your aegis of assault to teleport, you gain temporary hit points equal to 3 + your *Strength*.
